# NOMNC delivery and fast-track appeals (CMS)

- Citation: CMS Beneficiary Notices Initiative, https://cms.gov/Medicare/Medicare-General-Information/BNI/index ; CMS Manual transmittal on NOMNC: https://www.cms.gov/regulations-and-guidance/guidance/transmittals/downloads/dwnlds/r104mcm-.pdf ; Center for Medicare Advocacy on fast-track SNF appeals: https://medicareadvocacy.org/expedited-fast-track-medicare-appeals-in-skilled-nursing-facilities-in-light-of-the-jimmo-v-sebelius-settlement-agreement/
- Tier: 1 (CMS) / 2 (advocacy)
- Key rules: when an MA plan has approved a SNF stay, the enrollee must get a NOMNC at least two days before covered services end. The enrollee can request a fast-track appeal to the BFCC-QIO; the plan must then give a Detailed Explanation of Non-Coverage (DENC). Incomplete or improper delivery can affect the notice's validity.
- Limits: from search summaries; the exact validity and liability rules were not read. VERIFY before relying on them.
